title: Result & MiniSchema
scenario: Build a small runtime schema parser and Result<T, E> module for decoding external API payloads under strict TypeScript (strict: true). Unknown wire JSON must be validated cleanly without type assertions, preserving nested field paths and falsy domain values (0, "", false).

milestones.title: Schema Types & Result Union
milestones.goal: Define discriminated Result<T, E>, ValidationIssue, SchemaError, and Schema<T> with mapResult and flatMapResult.

milestones.title: Primitive & Object Parsers
milestones.goal: Validate primitives and plain objects without trusting inherited prototype keys or dropping falsy values.

examples.input: objectSchema({ sku: stringSchema(), qty: numberSchema() }).parse({ sku: 'DESK-1', qty: 4 })
examples.call: objectSchema({ sku: stringSchema(), qty: numberSchema() }).parse({ sku: 'DESK-1', qty: 4 })

examples.input: objectSchema({ enabled: booleanSchema(), tier: literalSchema('pro') }).parse({ enabled: true, tier: 'pro' })
examples.output: { ok: true, value: { enabled: true, tier: 'pro' } }
examples.call: objectSchema({ enabled: booleanSchema(), tier: literalSchema('pro') }).parse({ enabled: true, tier: 'pro' })

examples.explanation: Strings are not coerced into numbers.

milestones.title: Union & Nested Error Paths
milestones.goal: Implement arraySchema, optionalSchema, and unionSchema preserving nested paths and every branch failure.

examples.input: objectSchema({ id: stringSchema(), note: optionalSchema(stringSchema()) }).parse({ id: 'USR-1' })
examples.output: { ok: true, value: { id: 'USR-1', note: undefined } }
examples.call: objectSchema({ id: stringSchema(), note: optionalSchema(stringSchema()) }).parse({ id: 'USR-1' })

milestones.title: Strict Unknown Narrowing & Wire Decoding
milestones.goal: Decode raw JSON wire payloads cleanly with decodeApiPayload and exhaustive formatDecodeError.

examples.input: decodeApiPayload('{"page":2,"limit":25}', objectSchema({ page: numberSchema(), limit: numberSchema() }))
examples.call: decodeApiPayload('{"page":2,"limit":25}', objectSchema({ page: numberSchema(), limit: numberSchema() }))

examples.input: formatDecodeError({ kind: 'validation-failed', issues: [{ path: 'limit', message: 'Expected a finite number' }] })
examples.call: formatDecodeError({ kind: 'validation-failed', issues: [{ path: 'limit', message: 'Expected a finite number' }] })

review.note: No leaks appear in README.md, stubs, or tests, the api-payload-schema-validator domain is realistic and distinct from other labs, all PRG-T01-C02 units and milestone qualityChecks fit cleanly with zero must findings in _reference src, and all four trapMutants embody realistic bugs caught by hidden tests.
